'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Pope Francis]] accuses the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] of committing [[war crime]]s, in response to [[Israel]]i [[sniper]]s killing two [[Palestinian Christians]] and injuring seven others who were taking refuge in the [[Holy Family Church, Gaza|Holy Family Church]] in [[Gaza City]] yesterday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/pope-francis-deplores-israeli-killings-civilians-gaza-church-2023-12-17/ (Reuters)]
***The [[Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (France)|French Foreign Ministry]] condemns Israel's the bombing of [[Rafah]] four days earlier for killing one of its staff members, and demands an "immediate and durable" [[ceasefire]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/17/france-condemns-death-of-its-agent-in-gaza-residential-house-bombing (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes (2023–2024)|Jabalia airstrikes]]
***[[Israeli Air Force]] [[airstrike]]s in [[Jabalia]] kill at least 90 people, according to the [[Gaza Health Ministry]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/israel-hamas-war-day-72-1.7061980 (CBC)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Salvatierra massacre]]
***In [[Mexico]], twelve people are killed during a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Christmas season]] party in [[Salvatierra, Guanajuato|Salvatierra]], [[Guanajuato]]. Three others are killed and four injured at a bar in [[Tulum Municipality|Tulum]], [[Quintana Roo]], while four people are killed in [[Salamanca, Guanajuato|Salamanca]], Guanajuato. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-16-killed-christmas-season-drug-cartels-a78f763cfc65b993f595c7fadb56eb33 (AP)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Wad Madani]]
***The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] says that it has repelled a [[Rapid Support Forces]] (RSF) assault on [[Wad Madani]], the capital of [[Gezira State]]. The RSF reportedly withdraws following heavy resistance. [https://sudantribune.com/article280457/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Syrian Armed Forces|Military]] [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] in [[Aleppo Governorate]] kills six [[civilian]]s in [[Darat Izza]] and two in Abzimou. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/syria-eight-civilians-killed-syria-army-rebel-bastion (Middle East Eye)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Civil Aviation Authority (United Kingdom)|Civil Aviation Authority]] approves [[SaxaVord Spaceport]] on the [[Scottish island]] of [[Unst]] as the [[United Kingdom]]'s first [[spaceport]] for vertical rocket launches. The first launches are expected to take place in 2024. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-north-east-orkney-shetland-67741864 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Nine workers are killed and three others are injured by an [[explosion]] at a factory in [[Nagpur district]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/9-workers-killed-3-injured-in-blast-at-fire-factory-in-western-india/3084977 (AA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Serbian parliamentary election]]
**[[Serbians]] elect members of the [[National Assembly (Serbia)|National Assembly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbians-vote-snap-election-ruling-party-set-secure-another-term-2023-12-17/ (Reuters)]
**[[President of Serbia|President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]] declares victory for his [[Serbian Progressive Party]], claiming a [[Majority government|majority]] with 127 seats, while [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] leader [[Radomir Lazović]] of the [[Green–Left Front]] raises concerns of [[Electoral fraud|electoral irregularities]] including [[vote buying]] and [[Preference falsification|falsification]]. [https://www.news.com.au/breaking-news/serbia-votes-in-doubleheader-elections/news-story/4012ab51637e254aa2fd8482dbfa69f0 (AFP via news.com.au)]
*[[2023 Chadian constitutional referendum]] 
**[[Chadians]] vote in a [[referendum]] on a new [[Constitution of Chad|constitution]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2427151/world (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*[[2023 Chilean constitutional referendum]]
**By a margin of 56% to 44%, [[Chileans]] vote to reject the proposed new [[Constitution of Chile|constitution]] drafted by the [[Constitutional Council (Chile)|Constitutional Council]]. [https://apnews.com/article/chile-new-constitution-referendum-f7be231ff564856f6a5e1b0c0ac12c57 (AP)]
